text: When an ECP5 CIC's 25-bit integrator and comb carry chains are timing-limited at 77.3 MHz because pipe_integ and pipe_comb are false, enable both pipelining stages so each chain becomes one adder/subtractor around the decimator, lifting Fmax to 151.0 MHz (+73.7 MHz) for +41 LUTs and no DSPs.

For an ECP5 CIC that is already feasible at 150.99 MHz with a carry-chain-limited integrator[0] path, do not enable reg_in, because it expands the integrator carry chain from 11 to 14 cells, lengthens the critical path from 6.62 to 6.82 ns, and drops Fmax to 146.71 MHz, losing feasibility while the integrator chain remains critical.

On ECP5 CIC, when the 3-subtractor comb chain is timing-critical at 146.7 MHz, disabling comb pipelining (pipe_comb=false) to save 29 LUTs chains the subtractors into an 18-cell carry chain (9.7 ns), dropping Fmax by 43.6 MHz to 103.1; keep a register between comb stages instead.

On an ECP5 CIC whose 25-bit datapath is timing-limited at 75.2 MHz by an unregistered 17-cell integrator carry chain in series with an 8-cell comb-subtractor carry chain, pipeline-register the integrator and comb stages rather than leaving them combinational, which splits the 13.3 ns critical path into a 3.69 ns registered carry-chain segment and raises Fmax to 270.7 MHz for +6 LUTs and no DSPs.

When an ECP5 CIC is already feasible and comb-limited by a 25-cell carry-chain subtractor (c_x[2]→c_x[3], 3.69 ns) at 270.7 MHz, disable reg_in to remove only the integrator[0] input padding, yielding +3.3 MHz (274.0 MHz) and −1 LUT at unchanged DSP usage.

When an ECP5 CIC datapath is timing-limited by a 13.3 ns serial unregistered 25-bit integrator carry chain plus comb subtractor carry chain at 75.2 MHz, register both the integrator and comb stages to split the path into independent single-adder segments (~3.65 ns), raising Fmax to 274.0 MHz (+198.8 MHz) for only +5 LUTs.

On an ECP5 CIC already feasible at ~274 MHz with both integrator and comb stages registered, skip the input register unless source-side routing is actually critical, because it lengthens the integrator carry chain from 18 to 25 cells and costs 3.3 MHz (273.97→270.71) for only +1 LUT and no DSP change.
